question: Train a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) regressor with one hidden layer (50 neurons, ReLU activation, random_state=42) to predict patient BMI from 100 SNPs (coded 0/1/2). Use standardized inputs (StandardScaler), 80-20 train-test split (random_state=42). Train with the Adam solver for up to 1000 epochs, using early stopping with patience=15 and a 20% internal validation fraction. Report test R^2 and MAE.
